Title: Allow URLs where username or password contains unescaped '@'.
BugEvidence: Software bug: valid URL userinfo containing an unescaped @ was parsed incorrectly; the issue gives a focused httpx.URL reproduction.
Reason: PR 2986 explicitly closes issue 2985, changes URL parsing with regression tests, and is merged. SHA is the PR head/fixing commit.

Title: httpx 0.24 documentation issue for netrc support
BugEvidence: Software/API documentation mismatch: the documented NetRCAuth() example raised TypeError because file was required.
Reason: PR 2667 says it fixes/closes issue 2666 and makes file=None the default, matching the documented example; it is merged.

Title: NetRCInfo.netrc_info() doesn't work when run in a systemd service with DynamicUser=true
BugEvidence: Software bug: ambient netrc discovery could fail when a service has no resolvable home directory; the report also documents the NETRC workaround.
Reason: PR 2535 explicitly closes issue 2532 and removes implicit NetRCInfo home-directory discovery in favor of explicit NetRCAuth configuration; the PR is merged.

Title: Async/await， read file error: greenlet.error: cannot switch to a different thread
BugEvidence: Not a confirmed Flask defect: maintainers traced the report to manual event-loop/gevent integration and advised using Flask's async-view loop rather than creating a nested loop.
Reason: The issue has no linked fixing PR. Maintainer guidance identifies application event-loop setup as the cause and says nested-loop integration is outside Flask's scope.

Title: Blueprint.errorhandler restricts type of result function which avoids chaining
BugEvidence: Software typing bug: valid stacking of Blueprint.errorhandler decorators failed static type checking.
Reason: Maintainer comment identifies PR 4487 as the change for issue 4297; its description addresses chained errorhandler typing and it merged. PRs 4305/4306 were closed unmerged and are not treated as fixes.

Title: error handler type check fails
BugEvidence: Software typing bug: valid exception handlers were rejected by mypy after a Flask typing change; the report includes a reproducible example.
Reason: PR 4298 explicitly fixes issue 4295 and adjusts the error-handler typing; it merged. Related PR 4296 was closed without merging.

Title: Type checkers complain when invoking super().method() if method was decorated with @model_validator
BugEvidence: Software typing bug: inherited decorated model-validator methods are not callable to type checkers; the issue includes a minimal example.
Reason: The issue is open and describes a reproducible defect, but no reliable PR or commit reference was found in the issue timeline or issue metadata.

Title: `ensure_ascii=True` behaves differently from Python's `json.dumps` for lone Unicode surrogates
BugEvidence: Unclear: the serialization difference is reproducible, but the reporter explicitly asks whether rejecting lone surrogates is intentional or a behavior that should be added.
Reason: No maintainer decision, linked fix, or documentation statement resolving the compatibility question was found; do not infer a defect solely from the requested parity.

Title: TypedDict config is ignored for a shared TypeAliasType (regex_engine and str_to_upper)
BugEvidence: Software configuration-propagation bug: a shared TypeAliasType loses its TypedDict configuration, affecting regex_engine and str_to_upper behavior.
Reason: PR 14257 explicitly addresses the issue's regex_engine case, but was closed unmerged and its body says the str_to_upper variant is outside its scope. It is not evidence of a shipped fix.

Title: `error_later` is silently dropped when a test wraps `warnings.showwarning`
BugEvidence: Software bug report: a forwarding warnings.showwarning wrapper causes the proposed error_later filter to lose its verdict and let a test pass.
Reason: The maintainer says the fix was folded into PR 15135 and closes this report as outdated, but PR 15135 is still open/draft and unmerged at review time.

Title: fixtures: `--fixtures-per-test` has an off-by-one on item's lineno
BugEvidence: Software bug: the fixtures-per-test report prints the item's source line one too high.
Reason: PR 15053 explicitly fixes issue 15052 by removing the extra line increment, and is merged.

Title: fixtures: `--fixtures-per-test` crashes on fixture-using doctest
BugEvidence: Software crash bug: fixtures-per-test assumes a DoctestItem has a function attribute and raises AttributeError.
Reason: PR 15055 explicitly says it fixes issue 15051 and targets the reported crash, but remains open and unmerged.

Title: Issue: Flutter Web Debug Stack Overflow with Large MultiBlocProvider Configuration
BugEvidence: Unclear: a stack overflow is reported with 119 providers, but the report itself suspects Flutter Web/debug runtime or provider-tree limits and supplies no minimal package-only reproduction or maintainer diagnosis.
Reason: No fix PR or commit was linked. The reported failure is real to the reporter, but ownership/root cause in bloc versus Flutter/runtime/application architecture is unestablished.

Title: fix: `_isOverride` is never reset, so lint rules skip every member after an `@override`
BugEvidence: Software lint bug: shared parser metadata state leaks the @override exemption to later members and can also produce a false positive.
Reason: PR 4864 explicitly closes issue 4863 and describes targeted state-reset changes and regression tests, but it remains open and unmerged.

Title: fix: Freezed requires abstract class or multiple factory constructors for non-abstract class with single factory
BugEvidence: Software/tooling bug in bloc's Freezed templates: generated non-abstract single-factory examples conflict with Freezed's abstract-class requirement; this is not evidence of a defect in Freezed itself.
Reason: PR 4840 explicitly fixes issue 4815 by updating bloc templates to use abstract classes; the PR is open and unmerged.

Title: StreamProvider retains obsolete dependency subscriptions across rebuilds
BugEvidence: Software resource-lifecycle bug: dependency listeners accumulate across successful StreamProvider rebuilds until final disposal.
Reason: PR 4954 explicitly fixes issue 4953 and states that obsolete subscriptions are released after replacement-stream events; it is merged.

Title: only_use_keep_alive_inside_keep_alive reports a KeepAliveLink message and reversed correction
BugEvidence: Software/user-facing lint bug: the diagnostic describes the wrong rule and its suggested correction reverses the necessary keepAlive change.
Reason: PR 4952 explicitly fixes issue 4951 by correcting the message and remedy; the PR is merged.

Title: Overriding one instance of a family in a nested scope leaks the override into the parent container (3.x regression)
BugEvidence: Software regression: a child-scope family override mutates a shared parent directory, so the parent reads the child's value.
Reason: PR 4903 explicitly fixes issue 4902 with a directory copy and regression tests; it is open and unmerged. PR 4910 also claims a side-effect fix but is open, so neither proves a shipped correction.

Title: native_dio_adapter: Response.realUri is always the request URL after a redirect
BugEvidence: Software bug: NativeAdapter loses the final redirected URL, leaving Response.realUri and redirect metadata incorrect.
Reason: PR 2630 explicitly closes issue 2631 and adds the final URL as redirect metadata, but remains open and unmerged.

Title: Cancelling a response stream subscription leaves the adapter response subscribed
BugEvidence: Software resource-lifecycle bug: cancelling a consumer subscription leaves the adapter response stream subscribed and cleanup incomplete.
Reason: PRs 2617 and 2624 both explicitly address the cancellation leak with tests, but both are open and unmerged; PR 2624 is recorded as the primary link.

Title: Duplicate handler completion can crash silently (untraceable) or throw an unguarded StateError during flaky connectivity
BugEvidence: Software error-handling bug: duplicate interceptor completion can raise an unguarded, detached StateError; the report includes a reproducer.
Reason: PR 2611 explicitly fixes issue 2613 with duplicate-completion guards and request context, but remains open and unmerged.

Title: [cloud_firestore] iOS/macOS: snapshot stream handlers keep calling the FlutterEventSink after onCancel
BugEvidence: Software native lifecycle bug: queued Firestore callbacks may invoke a FlutterEventSink after cancellation; the issue cites repeated sanitizer/Zombies observations and code paths.
Reason: A detailed native race and code-path report is present, but no linked PR or commit was identified; the issue remains open.

Title: [cloud_firestore][Windows] FirestoreCodec settings decoding still ignores persistenceEnabled: false (remaining half of #18659)
BugEvidence: Unclear: the codec path appears to omit persistenceEnabled, but the reporter says they have not established that this path is reached in current releases.
Reason: The issue is open and maintainers are investigating, but no independent reproduction, reachable-path confirmation, or linked fixing PR/commit was available.

Title: [cloud_firestore][Windows] Invalid field names (empty or `__x__`) close the app instead of throwing a FirebaseException
BugEvidence: Software crash/error-translation bug: the report traces invalid Firestore field names to uncaught native C++ exceptions and provides production minidump evidence.
Reason: The report provides a specific native failure path and production observations, but no linked PR or commit was found; the exact isolated sample is acknowledged as untested.

Title: [Bug]: (share_plus) iOS drops the subject when sharing a uri
BugEvidence: Software platform bug: the iOS URI-sharing path passes a nil subject although ShareParams.subject is documented as supported.
Reason: Draft PR 3997 explicitly fixes issue 3994 and adds iOS tests, but is open and unmerged.

Title: [Bug]: New version of nm package
BugEvidence: Dependency compatibility/update request: connectivity_plus constrained nm to ^0.5.0, preventing consumers from selecting nm 0.6.0; no runtime defect is described.
Reason: PR 3988 updates the dependency and is merged, but this sample is a dependency-version support request rather than evidence of a software defect; its merged status is not counted as a verified bug fix.

Title: [Bug]: Subject message is ignored(First sentence of text is taken instead)
BugEvidence: Unclear: the issue reports subject handling for text sharing to Gmail on iOS, but provides no logs and labels itself duplicate of older reports; confirmed URI-path PR 3997 is a distinct flow.
Reason: No linked fixing PR was found for this text-sharing path. The URI-sharing PR 3997 does not demonstrate a fix for the separate text-sharing report.

Title: 0.142.0: app fails to start when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set but the opentelemetry extra isn't installed
BugEvidence: Software startup regression: a generic OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable caused startup failure when FastAPI's OpenTelemetry extra was absent.
Reason: PR 16418 is explicitly related to the reported startup failure, changes automatic telemetry setup failure handling, and is merged.

Title: app.frontend() with fallback="index.html" returns 404 for client side routes that have a dot in the last path segment (like /users/john.doe or /v/1.2.3)
BugEvidence: Software routing bug: dotted client-side routes incorrectly returned 404 instead of the configured index.html fallback.
Reason: Maintainer confirms PR 16011 fixed the issue and shipped in 0.139.1; PR 16011 is merged. Referenced PR 16198 was closed unmerged and is not counted as the fix.

Title: 0.137.0: `APIRoute.tags` invisible to type checkers in generate_unique_id_function (regression from #15745)
BugEvidence: Software typing regression: the documented APIRoute.tags attribute was missing from the static type surface while remaining available at runtime.
Reason: The maintainer explicitly says PR 15765 fixed the issue and shipped in 0.137.1; PR 15765 is merged. Later PR 16199 was closed unmerged.
